flowNote: Green is done. Amber is in progress. Grey is not started. Yellow diamonds are decisions, not screens. After a valid OTP the app checks whether the mobile is already registered. Existing user: the app checks for an active rental or material booking (any assigned machine / material order). If yes, Quick Booking opens first; Close/Back goes to Home. If none, go to Home. New user: Sign Up Completed popup — Contact us to Register opens Help & Support, or Register Yourself continues registration and then Home. Invalid OTP stays on the OTP screen. Rental-owner Quick Booking (9000000001) is done — 40 isolated cases. Material Vendor Quick Booking (9000000017) is done — Landing 6, Accept 1, Decline 1, Edge 6. Rental Home (9000000001) is done — Landing 11, Interact 17, Edge 12 (40 cases) plus Material Home 32. Open bugs #25 (Rental Home Back → launcher) and #26 (Rental Home rotation opens Account drawer). Rental Booking structure is scaffolded — 82 cases (RB-L16 / RB-I16 / RB-S16 / RB-E20 / RB-A14), all enabled=false until activation. Dev blocker #16 remains open for busy-operator Assign Confirm only. Operator Quick Booking / operator Start-End OTP UI deferred. 23 Sep: rental booking API lifecycle suite live — Accept→Assign→Start OTP→End OTP→completed on L2B-RNT-2026-1837E2 (7 PASS / 1 SKIP). Free-operator UI happy path PASSES on L2B-RNT-2026-F7D066 (FreeOperatorUiAcceptTest) — Confirm enables after Nauman, Accept completes, status operator_assigned; #16 scoped to busy slots.
